caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative bottle or vase with a narrow, elongated neck and a wide, flared rim at the top. The main body of the vessel is bulbous and features intricate surface patterns. The upper section of the bottle’s body is adorned with evenly spaced diagonal ridges running from the neck down to a midpoint band. The middle section of the vessel is encircled by a band of geometric and floral motifs, consisting of circular rosette-like designs with radiating petals set within a crisscross pattern of lines. Below this, the lower part of the vessel displays a series of vertical oval shapes in relief. The bottle is uniformly colored in shades of brownish-olive with darker and lighter areas that suggest highlights and shadows, giving the impression of a glossy, reflective surface. The background is a plain, pale beige or off-white, and there is a faint artist signature at the lower right corner. There are no other objects or scenery in the composition.
title: Bottle
